tools.name: get_api_external_search
tools.description: Searches for products by barcode or name; returns a minimum of 1 and a maximum of 10 products. Billing per call: Credits: metered (~0.84 avg).

tools.name: get_api_external_getProducts
tools.description: Lists products using pagination. Billing per call: Credits: metered (~263.17 avg).

tools.name: get_api_external_last
tools.description: Retrieves the 20 most recently updated products along with their market prices. Billing per call: 0 Credits.

tools.name: get_api_external_product_of_market
tools.description: It returns the current price and details of the product based on the specified barcode and store name. Price history can also be included optionally. Billing per call: Credits: metered (~0 avg).

tools.name: get_api_external_marketList
tools.description: Retrieves the market names used in the filters. Billing per call: 0 Credits.

tools.name: get_api_external_history
tools.description: It retrieves the product's historical price information for the relevant store. Billing per call: 1 Credits.

tools.name: get_api_external_get_db_info
tools.description: It returns the username and password for accessing the MySQL database containing product information. You can use this endpoint by subscribing to the $100 plan. Billing per call: 1 Credits.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_api_external_get_db_info" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
